Filmmaker Priyadarshan doubts 'Hera Pheri 3' will be made

Filmmaker Priyadarshan has expressed doubt that the film 'Hera Pheri 3' will ever be completed, citing "lot of complications." He also revealed that he had rejected an offer for 'Bhagam Bhag 2'.
